name: Row of actions
layerWhy: It places actions by their weight; it decides no job of its own.
promise: Safe actions sit together at the end, the main one last; a destructive one sits apart.
expectation: The main action is where the hand expects it, and taking something away is never next to keeping it.
evidence: The destructive action is a section gap from the safe ones and in the danger treatment; on a phone the row stacks.
behaviour: Danger at the start, safe group at the end.
Wraps on narrow widths with the main action first in reading.
context: At the end of a form, a dialog or a detail.
relationships: It holds buttons; their emphasis ranks them.
The distance is the decision on destructive actions (0.5.0).
accessibility: Order in the markup is the reading and tab order.
failures: Never puts Delete between Cancel and Save.
do: One primary at the end of the group.
dont: Two destructive actions in one row.
